description: This file implements a logging utility for the openclaw project, including configuration resolution, log file management, and integration with external transports.

classes.name: PinoLikeLogger
classes.description: A lightweight adapter object that mimics the pino logger interface, wrapping a TsLogger instance.

methods.name: attachExternalTransport
methods.description: Attaches an external transport to a TsLogger instance, ensuring it is called on each log.

methods.name: buildLogger
methods.description: Constructs a TsLogger instance based on provided settings, configuring file and console transports.

methods.name: resolveSettings
methods.description: Resolves the current logging configuration, considering environment variables, overrides, and config files.

methods.name: isFileLogLevelEnabled
methods.description: Checks if a given log level is enabled based on current settings.

methods.name: getLogger
methods.description: Returns a singleton logger instance, creating or updating it if configuration has changed.

methods.name: getChildLogger
methods.description: Creates a sub-logger with specific bindings and optional level override.

methods.name: toPinoLikeLogger
methods.description: Converts a TsLogger into a pino-like logger interface.

methods.name: getResolvedLoggerSettings
methods.description: Returns the current resolved logger settings.

methods.name: setLoggerOverride
methods.description: Overrides the logger configuration for testing or special purposes.

methods.name: resetLogger
methods.description: Resets cached logger and configuration state.

methods.name: registerLogTransport
methods.description: Registers an external log transport function, returning a function to deregister it.
